text: Greenfield-parity DC-7: Capability 1 test-only code moved to a testing entry, unwired write guard deleted, conformance fixtures built through one builder.

measuredOn.validFor: the code commit and tree named here; any later edit to the files under packages/, apps/ or vitest.config.ts retires it (rule 10)

reachability.rule: name-based closure from apps/syzygy/src/main.ts over every non-test .ts under src/ in packages/cap1-core, packages/cap1-daemon, apps/syzygy; a module is reached when a reached module mentions, in comment-stripped code, a name it exports; index.ts barrels are definers only
reachability.text: The three unreached modules at head are exactly the deliberate test-support entry (testing.ts) and the two modules it exports; nothing else in the denominator is unreached.

exportCensus.scope: packages/cap1-core, packages/cap1-daemon, packages/cap1-system, apps/syzygy (non-test src, index.ts barrels excluded)
exportCensus.text: Test-only exports that remain are conformance-pinned domain functions, the test-support entry, cap1-system harness helpers, two discoverability-plane observers (syzygy-u2a.7) and minimalRootRoute (syzygy-bpyt.7.3).

testNameSets.command: npx vitest list (repository root config) at the base and at the code commit

callTrace.method: vi.mock wrapper over every lowercase function exported by @syzygy/cap1-core (and, at head, @syzygy/cap1-core/testing); each conformance-to-core call logs name and sha256 of its JSON-serialised arguments; class and constant exports are not recorded
callTrace.sortedFile: calls.sorted (the head file; the base file hashes identically)

builderByteEquality.mutantCheck: a copy of the built builder with spec_root: openspec/ changed to spec_root: openspec gave cases=25 byte-equal=0 unequal=25
builderByteEquality.sweep: git grep -l -F "spec_root: openspec/" at the code commit over packages/cap1-conformance: fixtures/index.ts and req-003.conformance.test.ts (per-field fragment blocks, a deliberately different shape); git grep -l -F 'schema_version: "1"': those two plus req-032 and req-034 (deliberately invalid declarations)
builderByteEquality.importers: fixtures/index.js is imported by 28 of the 45 conformance test files

routeDifferential.method: spawn the REAL built daemon (apps/syzygy/dist/main.js) of each tree against each fixture; record status, content type and body for every route anonymous and with the machine bearer credential; mask ISO timestamps, ports, fixture and state paths only
routeDifferential.mutantCheck: a one-character change to the built routes-human.js (the absent-state authority sentence) changed 26 of 272 responses

mutants.text: rule 6: each mutant rewrites one fragment (asserted to occur exactly once), runs the stated command at the code commit, and restores the file byte for byte. Pass 1 (mutate-pass1.log) ran M01-M13 and E01-E05 from an earlier revision of mutate.py; pass 2 (mutate-pass2.log) ran M14-M17, S00-S02 and E04 again with tsc -b --force, because pass 1 reported E04 as survived only since tsc -b did not see the package.json change. The final mutate.py is the file stored here.

survivorNotes.M01-schema-version: [Observed] packages/cap1-core/src/declaration.ts:147-150 checks only that schema_version is a non-empty string, so no test can see its value; the old inline literal survives the same change
survivorNotes.M02-spec-root: [Observed] spec_root is read nowhere in packages/cap1-core/src (grep over non-test files returns no match); declaration.ts:234-237 accepts any mapping under declarations
survivorNotes.M05-consents-dropped: [Inferred] no test asserts the declared consent-id list; coverage takes consent records as a separate input
survivorNotes.M06-relations-dropped: [Observed] req-004 builds relations (req-004.conformance.test.ts:21) but asserts only project id, display name, revision, fact keys and field closure
survivorNotes.M07-profiles-dropped: [Observed] req-004 builds profiles (req-004.conformance.test.ts:22) but does not assert them
survivorNotes.M15-declarations-emptied: [Observed] declaration.ts:234-237 accepts any mapping, so an empty one is valid
survivorNotes.E05-barrel-readds-boundary: no standing check keeps test-only code out of the cap1-core barrel; the reachability sweep above is a one-time measurement
